lineage_policy.official_native_arrival: requires complete native timestamps and non-OPEN_METEO transport
lineage_policy.open_meteo: aggregator_republisher; may seed candidate calibration only; never native arrival, P1, or formal/live authority
lineage_policy.open_meteo_forward: observational_candidate_not_oos even after its target date passes; it never contributes OOS samples
lineage_policy.open_meteo_historical_oos: requires retained CLOSED_HISTORICAL_AWC_TRUTH contract; unbound historical rows are not OOS
lineage_policy.promotion: requires own strict OOS and activation; OOS of another system never transfers
